title: NyayaSetu AI Legal RAG Evaluation Dataset Schema
description: Standard schema for evaluating legal retrieval, ranking, and synthesis accuracy on Indian family-law Acts.

integrity_policy.const: Only queries with reviewer_status == 'reviewed' are scored in official benchmark metrics.

expected_document_ids.description: Document IDs as registered in ChromaDB metadata (e.g. A1955-25)

expected_section_ids.description: Statutory section numbers expected in relevant passages (e.g. 13B)

expected_answer_points.description: Key statutory legal concepts that must be represented in grounded answer

sample_queries.query: What are the requirements for mutual consent divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act?
expected_answer_points: Petition presented jointly by both parties to the marriage
Living separately for a period of one year or more
Not been able to live together
Mutually agreed that the marriage should be dissolved
sample_queries.reviewer_notes: Pending formal sign-off by practicing family law advocate.

sample_queries.query: पारस्परिक सहमति से विवाह विच्छेद के क्या नियम हैं?
expected_answer_points: एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक समय से अलग रहना
sample_queries.reviewer_notes: Pending formal sign-off by Hindi-speaking legal scholar.
